integrity: The theorem has a self-contained equivariant fold and Mayer–Vietoris proof, supplemented by exact finite computational crosschecks. Experiments are not a proof for unbounded \(n\) or \(\ell\); no independent audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Rational homology for the coordinate-permutation \(S_n\) action on independence complexes of generalized Mycielskians of \(K_n\), for \(n\ge2\) and \(\ell\ge0\); no integral-module splitting, canonical equivariant homotopy splitting, other symmetry groups, or persistence classification. Full literature novelty cannot be certified by indexed searching.
title: The symmetric-group homology modules of generalized Mycielskians of complete graphs
